mapper.select: select count(`coupon_id`) from `card` where `coupon_id` = #{couponId} and `org_id` != 0 and isnull(`org_id`) = 0

select `cci`.id as `couponId`, `cci`.name as `couponName`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, if(ISNULL(`cci`.`available_sale_end_date`), '不限售出时间', concat_ws(' - ', date_format(`cci`.`available_sale_start_date`, '%Y/%m/%d'), date_format(`cci`.`available_sale_end_date`, '%Y/%m/%d'))) as `saleSegment`, `cci`.`sold_amount` as `soldAmount`, sum(`ca`.`allocate_num`) as `allocateNum`, (select sum(`c`.`status` in (1, 2, 3, 4)) from `card` `c` where `c`.`coupon_id` = `ca`.`coupon_id` and `c`.`org_id` = `ca`.`org_id` group by `c`.`coupon_id`, `c`.`org_id`) as `soldNum`, `ca`.`org_id` as `orgId` from `coupon_common_info` `cci` inner join `coupon_allocate` `ca` on `cci`.`id` = `ca`.`coupon_id` where `ca`.`org_id` = #{orgId} and `cci`.`is_inservice` = 1 and isnull(`ca`.`allocate_user_id`) = 0 and isnull(`ca`.`allocate_date`) = 0
and `cci`.`name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `cci`.`type` in
#{item}
group by `ca`.`coupon_id`, `ca`.`org_id`

select `c`.`id`, `c`.`card_number`, `c`.`sold_target`, `c`.`sold_phone_number`, `cci`.`sold_amount` as `paidAmount`, case when `c`.`is_sold_and_pay` = 0 then 1 else 0 end as `charge`, case when `c`.`is_sold_and_pay` = 0 then `cci`.`sold_amount` else 0 end as `soldAmount`, case when `cci`.`type` = 4 then (select `bonus` from `recharge_card` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `bonus` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `c`.`card_number` = #{cardNumber} and `c`.`card_password` = #{cardPassword}

select `temp`.`cardId`, `temp`.`couponId`, `temp`.`card_number`, `temp`.`ownerId`, `temp`.`couponName`, `temp`.`couponType`, ifnull(`temp`.`useDeadline`, '永久有效') as `useDeadline`, `temp`.`useWay`, `temp`.`mixable`, `temp`.`path`, `temp`.`limitCount` from (select `c`.`id` as `cardId`, if(`c`.`org_id` = 0, `c`.`third_card_number`, `c`.`card_number`) as `card_number`, `c`.`patient_id` as `ownerId`, `cci`.id as `couponId`, `cci`.`name` as `couponName`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select `mixed_use_type` from `vouche_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select `mixable` from `discount_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `mixable` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select `mixable` from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `mixable`, case when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `use_way` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select `use_way` from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `useWay`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `vouche_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.coupon_id) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `discount_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select if(isnull(activation_deadline), if(`effective_days` = 0, null, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval `effective_days` day), '%Y-%m-%d')), if(activation_deadline < date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'), activation_deadline, date_format(date_add(`c`.`active_date`, interval ifnull(`effective_days`, 0) day), '%Y-%m-%d'))) from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `useDeadline`, case when `cci`.`type` in (0, 1) then (select if(count(*) = 0, 1, 0) from `card_benefit` `bd` where `bd`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and `bd`.`benefit_type` = 1 and `bd`.`is_deleted` = 0) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select if(count(`bd`.`card_id`) = 0, null, count(`bd`.`card_id`) < (select sum(count) from `package_coupon_item` `pci` where `pci`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` group by `pci`.`coupon_id`) ) from `card_benefit` `bd` where `bd`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and `bd`.`benefit_type` = 1 and `bd`.`is_deleted` = 0) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select if(count(`bd`.`card_id`) = 0, null, count(`bd`.`card_id`) < (select sum(count) from `special_package_coupon_item` `spci` where `spci`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` group by `spci`.`coupon_id`) ) from `card_benefit` `bd` where `bd`.`card_id` = `c`.`id` and `bd`.`benefit_type` = 1 and `bd`.`is_deleted` = 0) else null end as `itemUseable`, (select `cfi`.`path` from `coupon_file_info` `cfi` where `cfi`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` and `cfi`.`inservice` = 1 and `cfi`.`file_type` = 0 ORDER BY `cfi`.`crt_time` asc LIMIT 1) as `path`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select count(*) from `vouche_coupon` `vc` where `vc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `vc`.`useable_clinci`)) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then (select count(*) from `discount_coupon` `dc` where `dc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `dc`.`useable_clinic`)) when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select count(*) from `package_coupon` `pc` where `pc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `pc`.`useable_clinic`)) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select count(*) from `special_package_coupon` `spc` where `spc`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` and find_in_set(#{orgId}, `spc`.`useable_clinic`)) else null end as `useClinicCount`, case when `cci`.`type` = 0 then (select `limit_count` from `vouche_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 1 then 1 when `cci`.`type` = 2 then (select `limit_count` from `package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) when `cci`.`type` = 3 then (select `limit_count` from `special_package_coupon` where `coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id`) else null end as `limitCount` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `cci`.`is_inservice` = 1 and `c`.`status` in (2,3) and `cci`.`type` != 4 and (`c`.`patient_id` = #{patientId} or (find_in_set(#{patientId}, `c`.`sharer`)))) `temp` where (isnull(`temp`.`useWay`) = 1 and `temp`.`itemUseable` = 1 or (`temp`.`useWay` = 0 and isnull(`temp`.`itemUseable`) = 1 or (`temp`.`useWay` = 1 and (`temp`.`itemUseable` = 1 or isnull(`temp`.`itemUseable`) = 1)))) and `temp`.`useClinicCount` > 0 and (isnull(`temp`.`useDeadline`) = 1 or `temp`.`useDeadline` >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'))

select cci.id as couponid, cci.name as couponname, case when cci.type = 0 then ( select vc.limit_count from vouche_coupon vc where vc.coupon_id = cci.id ) when cci.type = 2 then ( select pc.limit_count from package_coupon pc where pc.coupon_id = cci.id ) when cci.type = 3 then ( select spc.limit_count from special_package_coupon spc where spc.coupon_id = cci.id ) else null end as limitcount from coupon_common_info cci where cci.id = #{couponId} and cci.is_inservice = 1;
